annotate.trigger: Reusable progress/shadow defaults and complete-read metadata were required; diagnostics then reproduced three false-publication boundaries

atomize.contract: Synchronous borrowed shadows, one count/SHA-256 state per open, input EOF plus clean close before capture; existing ownership and checked failures retained

document.compatibility: Default methods retain the single abstract content-open method. Existing stream factories remain. Named observing factories avoid overload ambiguity. No native ABI is changed by this extension.
document.cost: The capture retains metadata and references, not payload or an AST. Byte hashing and any chosen parser still do real work; no benchmarked negligible-cost claim is made.
document.lesson: EOF describes bytes observed; successful completion is a separate terminal lifecycle event. A resource owner must carry its cleanup outcome through every wrapper that can publish evidence.
document.next_pass: Read this record and the linked logs first; compare exact source seals and preserve all three terminal regression fixtures before changing completion or ownership.
document.replay: Run the seven-test canonical recipe crate, admit its exact generated-target outputs, then run the retained generated-only runtime and image commands.
